sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Assault Rifles is a Combat skill in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Assault rifles handling skill improves the overall handling, reduces recoil and reload time of Assault rifles.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Level 10 of this skill is needed for the story chapter Batya

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
- Increases reload speed (0.4% per level → +20% at Elite Level)
- Increases weapon switching speed (0.8% per level → +40% at Elite Level)
- Reduces weapon recoil (0.3% per level → -15% at Elite Level)
- Improves weapon ergonomics (0.2% per level → +10% at Elite Level)
- Elite level: Steady aim for the first 3 seconds with any stamina condition
- Elite level: Doubles mastering gain

sections.heading: How to raise
sections.text:
- Landing hits on enemies with Assault rifles and Assault carbines
- Reloading Assault rifles and Assault carbines
- Cycling the action/Unloading the chambers of Assault rifles and Assault carbines
- Completing the quest The Cleaner
- Completing the quest Consolation Prize

sections.heading: Tips
sections.text:
- For weapons which can be top reloaded, each round reloaded counts as a separate reload. It is possible to quickly gain points by repeatedly reloading an SKS so long as the raid was started without a round in the chamber.
  - This will eject a round to the ground each time, so use cheap ammo or pick it up from the ground.
